        long x = total;
        if (p % 2 == 0) {

    private static long bin(long x, long st) {

            cur = cur * cur % mod;
            e >>= 1;

    private static long[] matrixPair(long x, long y, long st) {
        if (st == 0) {
            throw new StackOverflowError();
        }
        if (st == 1) {
            return new long[]{x, y};
        }
        long xm = x % mod;
        long ym = y % mod;
        long f2a = (xm * xm + ym * ym) % mod;
        long f2b = (2 * xm * ym) % mod;

            return new long[]{f2a, f2b};

        long c = (2 * xm) % mod;
        long d = ((ym * ym - xm * xm) % mod + mod) % mod;
        long[][] trans = {{c, d}, {1, 0}};
        long[][] power = matPow(trans, st - 2);

        long a = (power[0][0] * f2a + power[0][1] * xm) % mod;
        long b = (power[0][0] * f2b + power[0][1] * ym) % mod;

    private static long[][] matPow(long[][] base, long e) {
